notes: Self-contained WebGL first-person survival game set in an authored underground relay station. Includes pointer-lock mouse look, keyboard and gamepad movement, wall collision, animated pulse-driver view model, pursuing enemies, damage and hit feedback, three collectible cores, extraction and defeat states, restart, pause, locally persisted best time and settings, synthesised audio, fog, and a responsive HUD. JavaScript syntax and metadata JSON were validated. Headless Chromium was attempted but could not initialise WebGL in this environment, so in-browser rendering, pointer-lock and physical gamepad interaction remain unverified. Procedural geometry; no external runtime assets. WebGL availability is required.
